description: Declarative classification rules for City of Bradford MDC spending. Bradford is a metropolitan-borough unitary council covering all functions (Education, Adult Social Care, Children's, Highways, Housing, Waste). Default is procurement_paid. REDACTED variants bucket to direct_payment_individual. West Yorkshire Pension Fund pass-through. BACS / payroll aggregator entries handled.

match.supplier_regex: ^(\[REDACTED\]|REDACT(ED)?([ \-,].*)?|NAME WITHHELD|PAYMENT TO AN INDIVIDUAL|PAYMENT TO INDIVIDUAL|PRIVATE INDIVIDUAL|INDIVIDUAL)$

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions covering ASC direct payments, foster carer / SGO allowances, CYP direct payments. Lawfully unnamed — not third-party procurement.

match.supplier_regex: ^(WEST YORKSHIRE PENSION FUND|CITY OF BRADFORD.*PENSION FUND|BRADFORD CHILDREN AND FAMILIES.*|BRADFORD CHILDREN'?S TRUST.*|BRADFORD CHILDRENS TRUST.*)$

rules.reason: West Yorkshire Pension Fund is the LGPS scheme covering Bradford. Bradford Children and Families Trust (BCFT) is the council-owned not-for-profit children's social care trust established April 2023 in response to Ofsted intervention — money flowing to it is an inter-council transfer, not external procurement (per lessons.md: council wholly-owned subsidiaries with no public trading identity merit internal_transfer).

match.supplier_regex: ^(BRADFORD DISTRICT NHS FOUNDATION TRUST|AIREDALE NHS FOUNDATION TRUST|BRADFORD TEACHING HOSPITALS NHS FOUNDATION TRUST|NHS WEST YORKSHIRE ICB.*|BRADFORD DISTRICT CARE NHS FOUNDATION TRUST)$

rules.reason: BCF s.75 pooled budget transfers to NHS commissioning bodies + trust reimbursements for jointly-commissioned services (Section 75 NHS Act 2006). Legally ring-fenced.
Bank-transfer aggregator or accounting suspense entries — not a third-party supplier.
